reader.requirement: At --std 85 a READ of an indexed file in sequential access mode must be Format 1: the Format 2 phrases KEY IS, INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY are refused there, and Format 1 (NEXT optional, AT END, INTO) reads in prime-key order.

edition-consulted.switches: Year < 2002 dynamic-mode NEXT requirement; returns at once for a sequential-access file
Year < 2002: AT END or INVALID KEY required (SR7)

reader.edition-search: The SR4 refusals (CheckReadKeyFormat; ScreenForbiddenPhrase through EditionContext.Removed, which switches on --permissive only) and the ReadKind switch carry no edition test; the listed sites are the READ-wide 85 arms on the same path.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: not for this rule; the 85-only SR7 arm additionally requires AT END on the Format 1 READ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f21_05 covers Format 1 on a sequential file and 1985-SR-IX_4_5_3-4 the INVALID KEY refusal; not KEY IS on a sequential file, NOT INVALID KEY, INTO, or a READ on a file that is not open

probes.printed: COBOL2269 READ AT END: this READ statement specifies KEY IS, and no general format prints both
COBOL0864 READ KEY on 'IXF': the file's access mode is SEQUENTIAL ... which has no KEY phrase; COBOL6826 (SR7)
COBOL1720 the NOT INVALID KEY phrase shall not be specified ... Format-1 sequential read; COBOL6826

probes.expected: Format 1 reads K1, then K2 (NEXT, INTO), then the at end condition 10; a READ on the closed file fails with status 47
dynamic access keeps Format 2 (INVALID KEY) and READ NEXT

probes.printed: COBOL6826 READ specifies no INVALID KEY or AT END phrase
probes.expected: a bare READ is refused at 85 by SR7, not SR4

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR4  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: A sequential-access indexed READ binds ReadKind.Next and every Format 2 phrase is refused: KEY by CheckReadKeyFormat (hard error), INVALID and NOT INVALID KEY by ScreenForbiddenPhrase (error strict, warning under --permissive).

refuter.evidence: Attack on the reader's bare-READ evidence: with a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure SR7 no longer demands AT END, so a bare Format 1 READ must compile. rd-use.cob (indexed, ACCESS MODE omitted, so sequential): READ IXF, READ IXF NEXT RECORD END-READ, READ IXF compile and print U1 K1 00 / U2 K2 00 / USE 10 / U3 10 (the at end condition reaches the USE procedure). With that USE in place: READ IXF KEY IS PK refused COBOL0864 (access mode assumed SEQUENTIAL); READ IXF INVALID KEY refused COBOL1720. Class c: READ ... WITH NO LOCK refused COBOL0900 (2002) and READ PREVIOUS refused COBOL0900 (2002). cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR4 the text is in SR4; OK §1985:IX.4.5.3 SR7 the text is in SR7.
